relations.name: invoice_fact
relations.meaning: A billed revenue record as represented in billing sources with amount, currency, period, and payment status.
relations.grounding_contract: One tuple per invoice row in sources/billing/invoices.json; each field copied verbatim from source.
relations.construction_rule: C1: Parse invoices.json; mint referent per invoice_id; assert one tuple per object with source row grounding.

relations.name: crm_account_fact
relations.meaning: A CRM account record with its operating name as given in the CRM export.
relations.grounding_contract: One tuple per data row in sources/crm.csv keyed by crm_account_id.
relations.construction_rule: C1: Parse crm.csv; mint referent per crm_account_id; assert account_name from source.

relations.name: registry_entity_fact
relations.meaning: A company registry row with registry number and registered legal name as recorded in the registry export.
relations.grounding_contract: One tuple per data row in sources/company_registry.csv keyed by company_number.
relations.construction_rule: C1: Parse company_registry.csv; mint referent per company_number; assert legal_name from source.

relations.name: contract_header_fact
relations.meaning: A contract or statement-of-work document with its source filename identifier and counterparty name as stated in the document header.
relations.grounding_contract: One tuple per sources/contracts/*.md file; contract_id is filename stem; counterparty_text from header line.
relations.construction_rule: C1: Enumerate contract markdown files; mint referent per file; parse Counterparty field from header.

relations.name: contract_temporal_fact
relations.meaning: Whether a contract document is currently in force according to explicit effective, term, and expiry dates in the source document.
relations.grounding_contract: active derived deterministically from document dates and explicit expiry statements; grounded to the temporal clauses in each contract file.
relations.construction_rule: C1: Parse Effective, Term, and Expiry lines from each contract markdown; set active false when an explicit expiry date has passed, true otherwise.

relations.name: record_identifier
relations.meaning: Canonical purpose-B identifier string for a source record referent in one of the prescribed system forms.
relations.grounding_contract: Deterministic rendering from compiled facts; no semantic judgment.
relations.construction_rule: C4: Derive from invoice_fact (billing:<billed_name>), crm_account_fact (crm:<id>), registry_entity_fact (registry:<company_number>), contract_header_fact (contract:<contract_id>). Register as DERIVED relation over fact tables.

relations.name: open_invoice_set
relations.meaning: Invoices whose billing status is open as recorded in source billing data.
relations.grounding_contract: Filter of invoice_fact; completeness universe is invoice_fact.
relations.construction_rule: C4: SELECT from invoice_fact WHERE status = 'open'.

relations.name: identity_judgment
relations.meaning: Two referents denote the same legal counterparty, are distinct, or remain unresolved.
relations.grounding_contract: Bounded packet. SAME_ENTITY and DISTINCT require establishing evidence, not compatibility.
relations.construction_rule: C2/C3: Assert pairwise judgments over rendered record_identifier strings for commercially linked records; ground each disposition to source evidence.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: Generate oriented pairs required to connect each CRM account to its billed name, governing contract counterparty, and candidate registry entities for that commercial relationship; exclude Cartesian product of all records.
relations.unresolved_judgment: Whether two specific records denote the same legal counterparty cannot be established confidently from authoritative sources.

relations.name: clause_kind_presence
relations.meaning: Whether a named contractual clause kind is present, explicitly absent, or cannot be determined from the contract text.
relations.grounding_contract: PRESENT and ABSENT require quoted or paraphrased contract text spans; ABSENT only when the document explicitly states silence, negation, or unrestricted terms.
relations.construction_rule: C2/C3: For each contract and applicable clause_kind vocabulary entry, classify contract text sections and term language; ground disposition to contract file passages.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: Cross product of each contract_header_fact referent with each clause_kind from the union of purpose A acquisition kinds and purpose C obligation kinds.
relations.unresolved_judgment: Contract text is insufficient or ambiguous to classify the clause kind as present or explicitly absent.

relations.name: invoice_governing_contract
relations.meaning: Which governing contract applies to a billed invoice's commercial relationship, or whether that linkage cannot be established confidently.
relations.grounding_contract: ASSERTED requires evidence tying the invoice to the contract (structured correspondence, identity chain, or explicit commercial notes); UNRESOLVED when required linkage evidence is missing or ambiguous.
relations.construction_rule: C2/C3: For each invoice, judge governing contract among candidates sharing counterparty identity paths; prefer mechanical name matches where identity_judgment is SAME_ENTITY; ground to billing, contract, CRM, registry, or commercial_notes.md.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: Each invoice paired with contracts whose counterparty is linked by SAME_ENTITY identity_judgment to the invoice billed_name (directly or via CRM/registry), plus any contract named in commercial_notes.md for that billed party.
relations.unresolved_judgment: The governing contract for an invoice cannot be identified confidently from authoritative sources.

relations.name: purpose_a_invoice_association
relations.meaning: Purpose A qualifying invoice row with contract linkage and association disposition under acquisition-exposure policy.
relations.grounding_contract: Derived from world relations; disposition maps SAME_ENTITY identity paths to asserted and UNRESOLVED identity or governing-contract linkage to unresolved per purpose_a disposition_mapping.
relations.construction_rule: C4: Join invoice_fact, invoice_governing_contract, contract_header_fact, contract_temporal_fact, clause_kind_presence, and identity_judgment; filter to active contracts with acquisition-relevant clause_kind PRESENT or rows blocked solely by unresolved identity or governing-contract linkage; map disposition to asserted|unresolved.

relations.name: purpose_b_identity_link
relations.meaning: Purpose B output link rendering identity_judgment tuples in prescribed identifier form with epistemic disposition.
relations.grounding_contract: Projection of identity_judgment over record_identifier; no new semantic assertions.
relations.construction_rule: C4: SELECT left, right, disposition FROM identity_judgment restricted to candidate pairs required for CRM–billing–contract–registry connectivity; order by left then right.

relations.name: purpose_c_dependency_row
relations.meaning: Purpose C dependency row per contract–counterparty combination under the two-part commercial-dependency test or unresolved when linkage is blocked.
relations.grounding_contract: Derived assembly; status dependent only when current-relationship and obligation-kind tests pass with resolved identity; otherwise unresolved per purpose policy.
relations.construction_rule: C4: Join contract_header_fact, contract_temporal_fact, clause_kind_presence (obligation kinds), open_invoice_set, invoice_governing_contract, identity_judgment, and record_identifier; apply purpose C two-part test; emit dependent or unresolved status; aggregate open_invoice_ids and sorted obligation_kinds at output render.
